description: This is the main activity source file for an Android-based Tic-Tac-Toe game. It manages the game state, user interactions, and updates the UI components accordingly.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main Android activity that handles the game logic and UI for Tic-Tac-Toe.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up UI references, and binds event handlers.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game state and UI to start a new game.

methods.name: onCellTapped
methods.description: Handles user tapping a cell, updates game state, checks for win/draw, and updates the UI.

methods.name: lockBoard
methods.description: Disables further moves once the game has ended.

methods.name: findWinner
methods.description: Checks the current board for a winner and returns the winning symbol if any.

methods.name: isDraw
methods.description: Determines whether the game is a draw.

methods.name: updatePlayerIndicator
methods.description: Updates the UI to show the current player.

methods.name: setBannerNeutral
methods.description: Sets the banner message to neutral state.

methods.name: setBannerWin
methods.description: Sets the banner message to indicate a win.

methods.name: setBannerDraw
methods.description: Sets the banner message to indicate a draw.
